s.note: Corn chips baked with black beans, cheddar and jalapeños, guacamole and salsa
s.how: Layer a 300g bag of corn chips with a drained tin of black beans, 200g cheddar and jalapeños and bake at 200C for 8 minutes. Mash 2 avocados with lime. Dice 2 tomatoes with onion and coriander. Spoon on with 150g sour cream.

s.n: Don't think, just do loaded fries
s.note: Crisp fries topped with melted cheddar and crisp bacon
s.how: Bake 1kg frozen fries at 220C until crisp. Fry 4 diced rashers bacon until crisp. Top the fries with 150g grated cheddar and bacon, grill 2 minutes to melt and finish with 150g sour cream, sliced pickled jalapeno and chives.

m.note: Butterflied prawns grilled in garlic chilli butter, with cos and cucumber salad
m.how: Butterfly 1kg green prawns in the shell. Brush with 80g butter melted with 3 garlic cloves, chilli, lemon zest and parsley. Grill for 2 minutes a side. Toss cos and sliced cucumber with lemon and oil. Serve with crusty bread for the butter.

w.note: Toasted marshmallows with salted caramel between sweet cookies
w.how: Toast 16 marshmallows over a fire or under the grill until golden. Spread 16 plain sweet biscuits with a little thick caramel and a pinch of sea salt. Sandwich each marshmallow with a square of milk chocolate between 2 biscuits and squash together.

d.note: Bourbon shaken with muddled lemon, mint and sugar syrup, over ice
d.how: For each drink, muddle half a lemon cut into wedges with 15ml sugar syrup and 6 mint leaves in a shaker. Add 60ml bourbon and ice and shake hard. Pour everything into a tumbler, top with crushed ice and add a big sprig of mint.
